_comments.note: Telegram credentials and the database connection are NOT in this file - they live in environment variables (TELEGRAM_API_ID, TELEGRAM_API_HASH, TELEGRAM_SESSION, TELEGRAM_CHANNEL, DATABASE_URL). This file has no secrets, so it's safe to commit to GitHub.
_comments.starting_balance: Your paper account's starting balance in dollars.
_comments.position_size_pct: % of CURRENT balance risked on each new trade.
_comments.max_exposure_pct: Once this % of balance is tied up in open positions, new alerts are skipped.
_comments.fee_pct: Simulated round-trip fee + slippage, applied to every trade.
_comments.timeout_minutes: Force-close a position after this many minutes if neither target nor stop hit.
_comments.fixed_target_multiple: Take-profit target for the 'Fixed target' portfolio.
_comments.scaled_stop_loss_pct: Stop-loss for the 'Scaled + trailing' portfolio if 2x is never reached.
_comments.scaled_trailing_pct: Once 2x is hit, remaining position exits if price falls this % off peak.
